content: For Spanish/multilingual CPU embeddings small enough for ARM CPU inference: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small (12 layers, 384-dim, 100 languages, designed to be CPU-servable) and sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (118M params, 384-dim, 50+ languages incl. Spanish) are the standard small multilingual sentence-embedding models usable via Bumblebee.Text.TextEmbedding.
